Build in the worktree /opt/nxeon-wt-host (branch feature/shared-hosting-p0, currently == main == commit d373909). Do NOT deploy and do NOT run prisma commands; just edit + `npx tsc --noEmit` to check types (node_modules is symlinked; if missing, `ln -s /opt/nxeon/node_modules node_modules` but NEVER run `prisma generate` — it would clobber prod's client). Commit your work on the branch at the end. Report a summary of files changed.

GOAL: The customer web-hosting panel is a single messy stacked page. Restructure it to match the VPS server panel (per-item page with tabs), and add the missing cPanel-class features. Follow the EXISTING conventions exactly.

STUDY FIRST (read these):
- VPS pattern to mirror: app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx + components/customer/ServerTabs.tsx (a ?tab=-driven tabbed dashboard on a per-[id] route).
- Current hosting: app/dashboard/hosting/page.tsx + components/customer/HostingClient.tsx (has AccountCard, FileManager, Backups, AppInstaller, GettingStarted, TaskFeed, QuotaTile — REUSE these, don't rewrite).
- Reusable panels: components/customer/cpanel/*.tsx (CronServicesPanel, DatabasesPanel, WebsitesPanel, AppsPanel — study for style; reuse if they fit).
- Backend patterns: lib/actions-hosting.ts (server actions: requireUser owner-or-admin checks, plan-cap checks in serializable tx, HostingTask queue via db.hostingTask.create), worker/hosting.ts (task handlers, the `run(conn, label, cmd)` SSH helper, isValidUnixUsername/isValidHostingDomain guards, renderHostingVhost/installVhost, accountPaths, HostingTaskKind enum), prisma/schema.prisma (HostingAccount/HostingTask/HostingDatabase/HostingTaskKind).

PART 1 — RESTRUCTURE (the primary ask):
1. Change app/dashboard/hosting/page.tsx into an ACCOUNTS LIST: each hosting account rendered as a compact card (domain, plan, status dot, a small usage summary) that LINKS to /dashboard/hosting/[id]. Keep the "Host another site / order" plan-cards section below (reuse the existing order flow from HostingClient).
2. Create app/dashboard/hosting/[id]/page.tsx — a per-account tabbed dashboard (server component; fetch the account via getHostingAccount, notFound if not owner/exists). Use a NEW client component components/customer/hosting/HostingTabs.tsx modeled on ServerTabs (?tab= deep-linkable, useState). Tabs and their content:
   - Overview: status, plan, PHP; the "Point your domain → <IP>" block WITH a live DNS→HTTPS stepper (not-detected / DNS ✓ / HTTPS ✓ — use a.sslActive + the pointTo fields); the usage meters (disk used/quota bar via a.diskUsedMB, inodes, sites, databases); SFTP username + reveal-password; the GettingStarted checklist.
   - Files: reuse <FileManager>.
   - Databases: reuse the DB create/list UI + the phpMyAdmin link placeholder (a disabled "Open phpMyAdmin — coming soon" button is fine; I'll wire it).
   - Domains: primary domain info + the NEW Subdomains UI (Part 2) + NEW Addon domains UI (Part 2).
   - Apps: reuse <AppInstaller> (WordPress + catalog).
   - Cron: the NEW cron UI (Part 2).
   - Backups: reuse <Backups>.
   - Settings: PHP version switcher, plan/upgrade info, and a danger-zone note.
   To do this cleanly, EXTRACT the reusable sub-components (FileManager, Backups, AppInstaller, GettingStarted, TaskFeed, QuotaTile, the DB panel, PHP switcher) out of HostingClient.tsx into components/customer/hosting/*.tsx so both the list and the [id] page import them. Keep their behavior identical.

PART 2 — ADD MISSING FEATURES (follow the HostingTask + vhost + serializable-cap patterns EXACTLY; every value that reaches a shell MUST pass isValidUnixUsername/isValidHostingDomain or a strict regex):
- Subdomains: schema model HostingSubdomain (id, accountId, label, fqdn unique, docroot, sslActive default false, status, createdAt). HostingTaskKind += CREATE_SUBDOMAIN, DELETE_SUBDOMAIN. Actions createSubdomain(accountId,label)/deleteSubdomain(id) — owner check, enforce plan maxSites across (subdomains+addon domains) in a serializable tx, queue task. Worker taskCreateSubdomain: mkdir docroot under /home/<user>/subdomains/<label>/public_html owned <user>:www-data 2750 + a placeholder index.html, write /etc/nginx/sites-available/hosting-<user>-<label>.conf (a server block for <label>.<primaryDomain> rooted at the docroot, PHP → /run/php/<user>.sock), enable + nginx -t + reload. taskDeleteSubdomain reverses. UI in the Domains tab (create form + list + delete), with a note: "add a DNS A record for <label>.<domain> → <node IP> (or a wildcard *.<domain>)".
- Addon domains: schema HostingAddonDomain (id, accountId, domain unique, docroot, sslActive, status, createdAt). Kinds CREATE_ADDON_DOMAIN/DELETE_ADDON_DOMAIN. Same pattern as subdomains but for a full external domain (its own vhost + docroot; SSL will be picked up by the existing hostingSslSweep if you make that sweep also consider addon domains — OPTIONAL, note it if you skip). Enforce the SAME cross-tenant domain-uniqueness guard the primary order uses (no other account may already own that domain). UI in Domains tab.
- Cron jobs: schema HostingCron (id, accountId, schedule, command, status, createdAt). Kinds CREATE_CRON/DELETE_CRON. Actions with owner check + a sane cap (e.g. 20). Worker writes the jailed user's crontab via `crontab -u <user>` (validate schedule is 5 cron fields; the command runs AS the jailed user so it's confined). UI in the Cron tab.

CONSTRAINTS: additive schema only (new models + enum values, nothing renamed/removed). All new worker handlers gated by the existing ENABLE_SHARED_HOSTING/SANDBOX checks like the others (inert until enabled). Keep the dead-simple Result type + Banner/useActionState patterns already used. Match the dark Nxeon UI (card/section-label classes, primitives). Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and fix all type errors in your files before committing. Commit with a clear message. Report which files you changed and any TODOs you left (e.g. phpMyAdmin wiring, email provisioning — those are intentionally left for me).

8	 * customer's bug, it is everyone's; these validators are the first line of that.

11	/** A syntactically valid domain for a name-based vhost (no scheme, no path). */
12	const DOMAIN_RE = /^(?=.{1,253}$)([a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z]{2,63}$/;
13	
14	/** True for a hostname safe to place in an nginx `server_name` / a cert request. */
15	export function isValidHostingDomain(domain: string): boolean {
16	  const d = String(domain ?? "").trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\.$/, "");
17	  return DOMAIN_RE.test(d);
18	}

20	export function normalizeHostingDomain(domain: string): string {
21	  return String(domain ?? "").trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, "").replace(/\.$/, "");
22	}

24	/**
25	 * A safe jailed Linux username for an account, derived deterministically and kept
26	 * short (Linux caps usernames at 32 chars; some tooling chokes past 16). Starts
27	 * with a letter, lowercase alnum only — nothing a shell could ever interpret.
28	 *
29	 * `seed` (email localpart or account id) proposes a readable base; `disambiguator`
30	 * (a slice of the account id) guarantees per-node uniqueness without a DB probe.
31	 * The result still has to pass `isValidUnixUsername` before use, and the caller
32	 * resolves any residual collision against the DB (`@@unique([hostingNodeId, username])`).
33	 */
34	export function deriveUsername(seed: string, disambiguator: string): string {
35	  const base = String(seed ?? "")
36	    .toLowerCase()
37	    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "")
38	    .replace(/^[0-9]+/, "") // must not start with a digit
39	    .slice(0, 8);
40	  const suffix = String(disambiguator ?? "")
41	    .toLowerCase()
42	    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "")
43	    .slice(0, 6);
44	  // Guarantee a non-empty body so the result always clears the min-length rule
45	  // even when both inputs sanitise away to nothing.
46	  const body = `${base}${suffix}` || "acct";
47	  return `nx${body}`.slice(0, 16);
48	}

125	 * On a shared box `disable_functions` is a real isolation control, not defence
126	 * in depth: without it a tenant's PHP can shell out (`exec`/`system`), fork out
127	 * of `open_basedir` (`pcntl_exec` — compiled into PHP, so it bypasses a naive
128	 * blocklist), rewrite its own env (`putenv` → `LD_PRELOAD`/`GCONV_PATH`

130	 * host via `ffi`/`dl`. Everything a tenant could use to break out of its pool
131	 * belongs here. Kept sorted-by-purpose + deduped.

134	  // Command execution — the classic RCE surface.
135	  "exec", "passthru", "shell_exec", "system", "proc_open", "popen",
136	  // Process control — pcntl_exec is compiled in and bypasses the above blocklist;

139	  // Environment + dynamic loading — putenv enables LD_PRELOAD-style escapes,
140	  // dl/ffi load native code straight past the PHP sandbox.
141	  "putenv", "dl", "ffi",
142	  // Filesystem jail-breaks — symlink/link can point out of open_basedir.
143	  "symlink", "link",
144	  // Misc host-reach / info-leak vectors.
145	  "mail", "error_log", "curl_multi_exec", "parse_ini_file", "show_source",
146	] as const;

148	/** The comma-separated `disable_functions` value for a pool config. */

150	  return [...PHP_DISABLED_FUNCTIONS].join(",");

163	 *            world-listable, so a peer can't enumerate the home.
164	 *  - webroot `2750 <user>:www-data` — owner (the tenant's FPM pool) read/write,

174	  home: { owner: string; mode: string };
175	  webroot: { owner: string; mode: string };
176	  tmp: { owner: string; mode: string };
177	  nginxGroup: string;
178	} {

180	    home: { owner: "root:root", mode: "711" },
181	    webroot: { owner: `${username}:www-data`, mode: "2750" },
182	    tmp: { owner: `${username}:${username}`, mode: "700" },
183	    nginxGroup: "www-data",
184	  };
185	}

189	export const FPM_REQUEST_TERMINATE_TIMEOUT = "120s";

192	 * The per-account PHP-FPM pool config (the PHP isolation boundary). Pure: given
193	 * the validated username + jailed paths, returns the exact pool file contents.
194	 *
195	 * open_basedir is scoped to the account home (+ the shared PHP lib) and NO
196	 * LONGER includes `/tmp`: PHP's tmp/session dirs are redirected into the home,
197	 * so a world-writable `/tmp` on open_basedir was just an unnecessary shared
198	 * surface between tenants. memory_limit + request_terminate_timeout cap a
199	 * single tenant from exhausting the shared box.
200	 */
201	export function fpmPoolConfig(username: string, home: string, webroot: string): string {
202	  const sock = `/run/php/${username}.sock`;
203	  return [
204	    `[${username}]`,
205	    `user = ${username}`,
206	    `group = ${username}`,
207	    `listen = ${sock}`,
208	    `listen.owner = ${username}`,
209	    `listen.group = www-data`,
210	    `pm = ondemand`,
211	    `pm.max_children = 6`,
212	    `pm.process_idle_timeout = 30s`,
213	    `chdir = ${webroot}`,
214	    `php_admin_value[open_basedir] = ${home}:/usr/share/php`,
215	    `php_admin_value[disable_functions] = ${phpDisableFunctions()}`,
216	    `php_admin_value[memory_limit] = ${FPM_MEMORY_LIMIT}`,
217	    `php_admin_value[request_terminate_timeout] = ${FPM_REQUEST_TERMINATE_TIMEOUT}`,
218	    `php_admin_value[upload_tmp_dir] = ${home}/tmp`,
219	    `php_admin_value[session.save_path] = ${home}/tmp`,
220	  ].join("\n");
221	}

223	/**

225	 *
226	 * In GRANT, `_` and `%` are LIKE-wildcards: an un-escaped grant on `nxuser_wp`
227	 * silently also grants on `nxuserXwp`, `nxuser_wpZ`, … i.e. a neighbouring
228	 * tenant's database. Escaping them (and the escape char itself) with a
229	 * backslash pins the grant to exactly one database.
230	 */
231	export function escapeGrantDbName(name: string): string {
232	  return name.replace(/([\\_%])/g, "\\$1");
233	}

235	/**
236	 * The scoped SQL that creates one account database + user and grants that user
237	 * privileges on THAT DATABASE ONLY.
238	 *
239	 * Security invariants (audited): the GRANT is pinned to the exact db via
240	 * escapeGrantDbName (no wildcard bleed into a peer's db), it is NEVER `*.*`,
241	 * and `ALL PRIVILEGES` at database scope confers no global FILE/SUPER (those
242	 * are server-level and cannot be granted by a db-scoped GRANT). Returns plain
243	 * SQL with real backticks; the caller shell-escapes for `mysql -e`.
244	 */
245	export function buildScopedGrantSql(dbName: string, dbUser: string, dbPass: string): string {
246	  const grantName = escapeGrantDbName(dbName);
247	  return (
248	    `CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS \`${dbName}\`; ` +
249	    `CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS '${dbUser}'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY '${dbPass}'; ` +
250	    `GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON \`${grantName}\`.* TO '${dbUser}'@'localhost'; ` +
251	    `FLUSH PRIVILEGES;`
252	  );
253	}

## What I built

**Part 1 — Restructure (mirrors `servers/[id]` + `ServerTabs`)**
- `app/dashboard/hosting/page.tsx` is unchanged but now renders the rewritten `HostingClient` as an **accounts list**: compact cards (domain, plan, PHP, status dot, storage/sites/DB summary, HTTPS badge) linking to `/dashboard/hosting/[id]`; FAILED accounts show inline retry. The plan-cards/order flow is kept below.
- New `app/dashboard/hosting/[id]/page.tsx` — server component, `getHostingAccount` (owner-or-admin, `notFound` otherwise), renders new `components/customer/hosting/HostingTabs.tsx` (a `?tab=` deep-linkable `useState` tab bar copied from ServerTabs).
- Tabs: **Overview** (status/plan/PHP, live DNS→HTTPS stepper that polls `getHostingAccount` until `sslActive`, disk/inode/extra-sites/databases meters, SFTP reveal, GettingStarted, TaskFeed), **Files**, **Databases** (+ disabled "Open phpMyAdmin — coming soon"), **Domains** (primary info + Subdomains + Addon domains), **Apps**, **Cron**, **Backups**, **Settings** (PHP switcher, plan info, danger-zone note).
- Extracted reusable pieces into `components/customer/hosting/*` with identical behavior: `FileManager`, `Backups`, `AppInstaller`, `DatabasesPanel`, `PhpSwitcher`, and `shared.tsx` (`QuotaTile`, `TaskFeed`, `GettingStarted`).

**Part 2 — New features** (additive schema; HostingTask + vhost + serializable-cap patterns; inert until `ENABLE_SHARED_HOSTING`/not-SANDBOX)
- **Subdomains** — `HostingSubdomain` model, `CREATE/DELETE_SUBDOMAIN` kinds, `createSubdomain`/`deleteSubdomain`, worker builds jailed docroot (`/home/<u>/subdomains/<label>/public_html`, `2750 <u>:www-data`, placeholder index) + `hosting-<u>-<label>.conf` vhost.
- **Addon domains** — `HostingAddonDomain` model, `CREATE/DELETE_ADDON_DOMAIN` kinds, same pattern under `/home/<u>/domains/<domain>/...`, with the same cross-tenant domain-uniqueness guard as the primary order. Extended `hostingSslSweep` to also issue certs for addon domains.
- **Cron** — `HostingCron` model, `CREATE/DELETE_CRON` kinds, cap of 20, worker rewrites the jailed user's crontab via `crontab -u <user>` from ACTIVE rows.
- Caps (subdomains+addons vs `maxSites`; cron ≤ 20) enforced in Serializable transactions; every shell-bound value validated in both action and worker via `isValidUnixUsername`/`isValidHostingDomain` + new pure helpers `isValidSubdomainLabel`/`isValidCronSchedule`/`isValidCronCommand`. New shared `HostingResourceStatus` enum. SANDBOX task sweep updated so the new resources settle in dev.
